desc: the STATE reporter while the host's link hangs (fix-021, 19.6.7): a hosts in stag0101 with b; at @190 b starts a shared scene (the development test hook TEST busy, 20 s: not joinable on every engine); c, a stranger, arrives at stag0101 meanwhile and its JOIN waits for the scene; at @197 the proxy holds a's packets for 50 s (half-open: a stays connected, his grace starts after 4 s).
